name: Under Maintenance
source:
Blaseball is elsewhere...

The events of Season 24 have left the teams of Blaseball scattered in more ways than one. Some managed to find shelter in the Hall or Vault, others were left entangled in a Black Hole (Black Hole). The rest, scattered across the sands of the Desert, and among the rest, the Core Mechanics.

Days are slow, with the Mechanics passing the time with projects, sailing the sands, and repairing their home, The Core. The Mechanics are no stranger to odd phenomena occurring in the desert: esoteric faults, rifts in space-time,  cessation of some fundamental law or another. Yet on one day in particular comes an impossibility. A visitor from the Hall.

[From [url=https://gray-lofi.itch.io/under-maintenance-blaseball]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Blaseball在别处……

第24赛季的种种事件让Blaseball的各支队伍四散各处，彼此间也变得更加疏远。有些队伍在大厅或金库找到了避难所，有些则被卷入了黑洞（黑洞）。剩下的人散落在沙漠各处，其中也包括Core Mechanics。

日子过得很慢，Core Mechanics靠着做项目、在沙海中航行，以及修缮他们的家园The Core来打发时间。沙漠中发生的怪事，他们早已见怪不怪：诡秘故障、时空裂隙，或是某条基本法则突然失效。但有一天，却发生了一件绝无可能的事。一位来自大厅的访客到来了。

[来源：[url=https://gray-lofi.itch.io/under-maintenance-blaseball]itch.io[/url]]
